sentence: This project builds a drug screening pipeline to find therapies that stop cell death in keratoconus.
This project tests whether the release of a brain chemical called acetylcholine supports attention.
This project builds computer methods that find the transcription factors driving cellular identity in developing and diseased cells.
This project studies how calcium controls an ion channel in cilia and how that may start cysts in polycystic kidney disease.
This project tests a CRISPR editing therapy to help cone cells survive in retinitis pigmentosa, using a mouse model.
This project studies genetic variants in congenital heart disease to find out how they change the way cardiac cells work.
This project studies how neural crest cell populations shape the skull and cause skull bones to fuse too early.
This project studies the factors that guide germ cell development in the male germline, which leads to sperm production.
This project studies what the protein Neuroligin-4 does at synapses, using human neurons made from pluripotent stem cells.
This project uses gene editing to study mitochondria in human heart muscle cells.
This project studies how viruses evolve and what barriers limit bunyavirus reassortment.
This project studies how genetic variants, age, diet, sex and mitochondrial DNA copy number affect Alzheimer's disease and longevity in mouse lines.
This project builds a rabbit model that lacks myeloperoxidase to study infection and inflammatory diseases.
This project coordinates a center that supports research on neuroHIV, including gene editing and imaging of virus-infected cells.
This project develops cardiac MRI methods to detect and monitor coronary microvascular disease in women with ischemic heart disease.
This project engineers Salmonella to help the immune system attack cold tumors.
This project teaches researchers how to analyze genetic data to find the genetic causes of complex traits.
This project builds a system that uses a small chemical molecule to quickly remove chosen proteins in human induced pluripotent cells.
